description: This Java source file defines an immutable event class 'ThingsOutOfSync' used to signal out-of-sync state of 'things' in a search index within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization and metadata handling for these event messages.

classes.name: ThingsOutOfSync
classes.description: Immutable event class representing out-of-sync 'things' in a search index that can be serialized/deserialized to/from JSON, with headers and metadata support, and identifiable by constant type information.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ThingsOutOfSync instance with given thing IDs and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingsOutOfSync event instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing the thing IDs from JSON.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Returns the collection of thing IDs associated with this event.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for this resource, empty in this case.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for this event.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on IDs and headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on IDs and headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns revision number, always 0 for this event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns empty, as this event does not have a timestamp.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the type string as manifest.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object based on schema version and predicate.
